title: GitHub - benjarogit/rezeptor: Install and run Windows software on Linux with tested Proton-GE recipes.
excerpt: Install and run Windows software on Linux with tested Proton-GE recipes. - benjarogit/rezeptor
content_html:
Install and run Windows software on Linux with tested recipes —
powered by Proton-GE, managed in a simple desktop app.

Photoshop, tax software (WISO), Steam games with online fixes, trainers, and more: each recipe knows how to install, repair, validate, launch, and uninstall cleanly.

This is the successor project.
Development continues here only. The older repositories photoshopCClinux, wiso-steuer-portable-linux, and crkcachy are archived — please open new issues and pull requests in this repo.

Support stays on GitHub Issues (not Reddit).

What you get

  • GUI launcher — pick a recipe, install, start, repair, or remove
  • Proton-GE only — no system Wine fallback in recipes
  • Status checks — optional validate on startup; refresh anytime (F5)
  • Host tools check — missing packages suggested once
  • Catalog & sources — official recipes plus a community path
  • Recipe sync — pull new/updated official recipes from the release bundle (Help → Update recipes)
  • Data under ~/.local/share/wine-software/

Quick start

git clone https://github.com/benjarogit/rezeptor.git
cd rezeptor
./setup.sh

Needs PyQt6 on the host (python-pyqt6 on Arch/CachyOS, or your distro’s package) when you use git clone or the tar.gz release (./setup.sh).

The AppImage bundles its own Python and PyQt6 — no host python-pyqt6 required (recommended on Bazzite and other immutable distros).

The Flatpak also bundles Python, PyQt6, and Proton-GE. Install from a release bundle:

flatpak install --user rezeptor-<version>-x86_64.flatpak
flatpak run io.github.benjarogit.Rezeptor

Or build locally: scripts/build-flatpak.sh (needs flatpak-builder).

Or download a release (tar.gz, AppImage, or Flatpak). Verify portable builds with sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS (tar.gz + AppImage).

Documentation

→ Rezeptor Docs

  • Deutsch · English
  • Local: pip install -r requirements-docs.txt && mkdocs serve

Recipes

Bundled official recipes (6 — click to expand)
ID Name Category Notes
photoshop Adobe Photoshop CC 2021 Graphics & Design Standard offline installer (22.0.0.35)
photoshop-m0nkrus Adobe Photoshop CC 2021 (m0nkrus 22.1.1.138) Graphics & Design Full pack + Neural / missing_libs / GenP (optional)
premiere Adobe Premiere Pro 2024 Video NVIDIA: CUDA via nvidia-libs
wiso-steuer WISO Steuer (Portable) Finance Portable under Proton-GE
master-pdf-editor Master PDF Editor Documents & PDF BYOS MSI 5.9 under Proton-GE (optional fix/ in pack)
halo-campaign-evolved Halo Campaign Evolved Games ElAmigos/RUNE · graphics presets · optional Steam Non-Steam · BYOS trainer

Full list by category: Recipe catalog (docs). Index: recipes/catalog.json.

Location Role
recipes/<id>/ Bundled / official
recipes/community/<id>/ Community

Submit ideas via Recipe Submission.

Contribute recipes & improve Rezeptor

Rezeptor lives from tested recipes and a shared core — you do not need to maintain a fork.

Goal Start here
New recipe (app/game you got running) Developer guide · ./scripts/new-recipe.sh · recipes/community/<id>/
Fix or extend core logic (prefix, validate, install steps, launcher) CORE-API · RECIPE-AUTHORING
Idea without a PR yet Recipe submission issue or a short discussion

Pull requests that add a working recipe or make core/ / the launcher more reusable for the next recipe are equally welcome. Run ./scripts/recipe-lint.sh and make recipes-check before opening a PR.

Versioning

Releases follow SemVer (MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH). Current: 1.1.21.

content_html_zh:
使用经过测试的配方在 Linux 上安装和运行 Windows 软件 — 由 Proton-GE 提供支持，在简单的桌面应用程序中进行管理。

Photoshop、税务软件 (WISO)、具有在线修复功能的 Steam 游戏、培训师等等：每个秘诀都知道如何干净利落地安装、修复、验证、启动和卸载。

这是后续项目。 开发仅在这里继续。 较旧的存储库 photoshopCClinux、wiso-steuer-portable-linux 和 crkcachy 已存档 - 请在此存储库中提出新问题并拉取请求。

支持仍保留在 GitHub Issues（而非 Reddit）上。

你得到什么

  • GUI 启动器 — 选择配方、安装、启动、修复或删除
  • 仅限 Proton-GE — 配方中没有系统 Wine 后备方案
  • 状态检查——可选的启动时验证；随时刷新（F5）
  • 主机工具检查 - 一次建议丢失软件包
  • 目录和来源——官方食谱加上社区路径
  • 配方同步——从发布包中提取新的/更新的官方配方（帮助→更新配方）
  • ~/.local/share/wine-software/下的数据

快速启动

git clone https://github.com/benjarogit/rezeptor.git
cd rezeptor
./setup.sh

当您使用 git clone 或 tar.gz 版本 (./setup.sh) 时，需要在主机上安装 PyQt6（Arch/CachyOS 上的 python-pyqt6 或您的发行版的软件包）。

AppImage 捆绑了自己的 Python 和 PyQt6 — 不需要主机 python-pyqt6（推荐在 Bazzite 和其他不可变发行版上使用）。

Flatpak 还捆绑了 Python、PyQt6 和 Proton-GE。 从发行包安装：

flatpak install --user rezeptor-<version>-x86_64.flatpak
flatpak run io.github.benjarogit.Rezeptor

或者在本地构建：scripts/build-flatpak.sh（需要 flatpak-builder）。

或者下载版本（tar.gz、AppImage 或 Flatpak）。 使用 sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS (tar.gz + AppImage) 验证可移植版本。

文档

→ 受体文档

  • 德语 · 英语
  • 本地：pip install -rrequirements-docs.txt && mkdocsserve

食谱

Bundled official recipes (6 — click to expand)
ID Name 类别 Notes
Photoshop Adobe Photoshop CC 2021 图形与设计 标准离线安装程序 (22.0.0.35)
Photoshop-m0nkrus Adobe Photoshop CC 2021 (m0nkrus 22.1.1.138) 图形与设计 完整包+神经/missing_libs/GenP（可选）
首映 Adobe Premiere Pro 2024 Video NVIDIA：通过 nvidia-libs 的 CUDA
世界标准化组织税 WISO 税（便携式） 金融 Proton-GE 下的便携式
master-pdf-editor Master PDF Editor Documents & PDF BYOS MSI 5.9 under Proton-GE (optional fix/ in pack)
光环活动进化 光环战役演变 Games ElAmigos/RUNE · graphics presets · optional Steam Non-Steam · BYOS trainer

按类别列出的完整列表：食谱目录（文档）。 索引：recipes/catalog.json。

地点 Role
食谱/<id>/ 捆绑/官方
食谱/社区/<id>/ 社区

通过食谱提交提交想法。

贡献配方并改进 Rezeptor

Rezeptor 依赖于经过测试的配方和共享核心——您不需要维护叉子。

Goal 从这里开始
新配方（您运行的应用程序/游戏） 开发者指南·./scripts/new-recipe.sh·recipe/community/<id>/
修复或扩展核心逻辑（前缀、验证、安装步骤、启动器） 核心 API · 配方创作
还没有 PR 的想法 菜谱提交问题或简短讨论

添加工作配方或使核心//启动器对于下一个配方更可重用的拉取请求同样受欢迎。 在打开 PR 之前运行 ./scripts/recipe-lint.sh 并进行配方检查。

版本控制

版本遵循 SemVer (MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH)。 当前：1.1.21。
